resources.string: Block SIM, network and device-based fingerprinting: generic user agent, no telephony data, hardened WebView for integrity tokens
Generate a new random SponsorBlock submission ID every day (inspired by Tor/Mullvad rotation)
Submissions to SponsorBlock use a random, rotating identifier instead of a persistent device ID.
Delete the SponsorBlock ID, WebView cookies and website storage used for integrity tokens
This resets your SponsorBlock submission ID and clears all WebView cookies and storage. Integrity tokens may need to be re-generated on the next video playback.
Always request trending and home feeds as if located in the US instead of your device country, so backends never learn where you live. Changes the content you see.
